title: Shonda Rhimes on How to Create Stories (and Products) People Want

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Hollywood and Silicon Valley seem so different, but are more alike than we think.
reader_summary.overview: Hollywood and Silicon Valley seem so different, but are more alike than we think. What challenges do tech startup founders and other creative founders -- like showrunners and executive producers -- similarly face? Both have to deeply understand and respect their audiences; learn how to scale themselves beyond one person.

key_points.text: Both have to deeply understand and respect their audiences; learn how to scale themselves beyond one person.
In the end, it’s all about creating a story (product!) that sticks.
In this conversation with Andreessen Horowitz cofounder and general partner Marc Andreessen, Shonda Rhimes -- executive producer, writer.
